title: Redline's opinion headings add an unsupported answer recipient and council decision authority
body:
> *This was generated by AI while building #488.*

## What to build

Investigate the unsupported heading claims measured in `post-opinion-flawed-3` of #488’s frozen native delivery campaign. This is outside #488’s terminal-delivery target. The run repairs the input’s mandatory flaws and delivers its complete artifact and report, but both independent judges fail C1 because two headings assert facts the supplied material does not establish. Naming those additions in the claim account does not supply their support.

The input says that the association wants the administration to measure time and ask users why they choose a booking route. The new heading “Föreningen vill få svar om tidsåtgång och bokningsväg” makes the association the intended answer recipient. The account acknowledges that the original sentence did not identify this recipient. The input recommends that the council retain telephone booking; the new heading “Kommunstyrelsen kan besluta om telefonbokningen” asserts the council’s decision-making authority. The account lists that assertion as an added claim. Neither addition is marked as unestablished or unresolved.

Judge a passes D1 and fails C1 on both additions. Judge b likewise passes D1 and fails C1 on the unsupported recipient/intention and decision authority. Both agree that the four frozen mandatory flaws were detected, corrected and reported, and that the complete artifact and applicable report reached the caller. No outside source was supplied to establish either added claim. Neither judge inferred whether the council actually has that authority.

The full packet is `docs/evaluation/editorial-488/runs/post-opinion-flawed-3/`: staged input, terminal response, both judgements, full native trace and separate audit, observed mechanical files and writable-root inventories. The install was exported from `5457c89405aece11b325937f9f07407f01974f7c`; seat `gpt-6.1-sol`, effort `xhigh`, Codex CLI `0.160.0`. The second arm uses unchanged product wording because the baseline did not reproduce the terminal-delivery fault. No editorial repair of this miss was made during #488.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Diagnose the two measured additions from the input, delivered artifact, account and preserved native trace; keep both blind judgements unchanged.
- [ ] Commit a prospective provider-native regression plan before runs, and make any wording change conditional on fresh reproduction against the current product.
- [ ] Preserve the mandatory corrections, accurate change account and complete terminal delivery while preventing unsupported additions or truthfully reporting what cannot be established.
- [ ] Record remaining actual misses separately and run the four project checks in CONTRIBUTING.md for any implementation.

---
Written against `5457c894`; measured while building #488 under plan-freeze `80ffe252`.

## Readiness addendum, 2026-10-03

Root has allocated this artifact-support target to the Redline owner, serializing actual shared REVIEW/correction edits with #504 and #505. Accepted #499 capture/preparation is a native prerequisite. Fresh target coverage is three response runs plus one file run on the exact opinion-flawed context, plus one response/file pair of a new complete independently validated context that explicitly supports both answer recipient and council authority. The four original mandatory repairs, unresolved missing standfirst reporting and complete delivery remain required.

Observe proposal creation, parent support/re-review and subsequent accurate accounting separately. A claim account supplies no source support; reply-check may report a difference without licensing the artifact. If fresh native own-target red confirms either unsupported addition, make one smallest causal candidate on measured runtime surfaces, retaining supplied scope/advocacy/facts and supported counterpart. No candidate merely because a historical checker noticed a report mismatch, and no widening its two-list role. A conservative one-judge semantic miss rule is frozen prospectively, preserving both readings; complete new conformance is independently validated before expectations freeze. Historical #488 judgements/account remain unchanged. Non-reproduction yields no speculative wording, with current outcome honestly retained. Final whole-current-method independent review, catalog when due and all four CONTRIBUTING checks are required.

Written against `4cf05813`.
